title: Normality with locally Noetherian fibres is fppf local on the target and smooth local on the source
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that the property of having locally Noetherian fibres and being normal is local in the fppf topology on the target and in the smooth topology on the source. The proof reduces the two locality statements to the ring-theoretic behaviour of normality under faithfully flat and smooth base change and reassembles them, so the content is the assembly of the local conditions. Retained author proof at lines 5614-5650.
